extraction.name: DocVQA
extraction.description: A dataset for Visual Question Answering on document images
extraction.creator: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset consists of 50,000 questions defined on 12,000+ document images. The document images are sourced from the UCSF Industry Documents Library.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The documents are organized under different industries and further under different collections. We downloaded documents from different collections and hand-picked pages from these documents for use in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The final set of images in the dataset are drawn from pages of 6,071 industry documents, ranging from as early as 1900 to as recent as 2018.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The images in the dataset are hand-picked to prioritize pages with tables, forms, lists, and figures over pages which only have running text. The majority of documents in the library are binarized, and the binarization has taken a toll on the image quality. We tried to minimize binarized images in DocVQA since we did not want poor image quality to be a bottleneck for VQA.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The annotation process was organized in three stages. In stage 1, workers were shown a document image and asked to define at most 10 question-answer pairs on it. In stage 2, a worker was shown an image and questions defined on it in the first stage and was required to enter answers for the questions. In stage 3, questions and answers are editable and the reviewer either accepts the question-answer or ignores it.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The models need to improve specifically on questions where understanding the structure of the document is crucial.
